rationale: Price is at 98.4% of today's range and within $0.03 of the session high, with the last candle showing a large volume spike (201K shares) pushing into that high — this is an extended, climactic move rather than a clean setup in either direction. With SPY down and VIXY elevated, the broader tape is unfavorable for chasing momentum, so the prudent action is to wait for a cleaner entry signal.
